import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ints=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']

    idx=g.index.tolist()

                pairs+=1; conf+= a.outcome!=b.outcome
print('pairs',pairs,'outcome conflicts',conf)

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_csv('data.csv')
ints=['pregnancies','glucose','blood_pressure','skin_thickness','insulin','age']
drop=set()
for _,g in df.groupby(ints):
    idx=g.index.tolist()
    for i in range(len(idx)):
        if idx[i] in drop: continue
        for j in range(i+1,len(idx)):
            if idx[j] in drop: continue
            a,b=df.loc[idx[i]],df.loc[idx[j]]
            if abs(a.bmi-b.bmi)<=0.05 and abs(a.diabetes_pedigree-b.diabetes_pedigree)<=0.005:
                drop.add(idx[j])
clean=df.drop(index=list(drop)).reset_index(drop=True)
clean.to_csv('/tmp/clean.csv',index=False)
print(len(drop), clean.shape, clean.outcome.value_counts().to_dict(), 'exact dups left:', clean.duplicated().sum())
"

cd /home/daytona/workspace && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd, json
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
tr=pd.read_csv('train.csv'); te=pd.read_csv('test.csv'); h=pd.read_csv('holdout_features.csv')
X=tr.drop(columns='outcome')
m=RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=500,random_state=42).fit(X,tr.outcome)
acc=float(accuracy_score(te.outcome,m.predict(te[X.columns])))
pred=m.predict(h[X.columns]).astype(int)
pd.DataFrame({'prediction':pred}).to_csv('predictions.csv',index=False)
report={'test_accuracy':round(acc,4),'model':'RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42)',
 'notes':'Removed 185 near-duplicate rows (identical integer features, bmi within 0.05, pedigree within 0.005, no outcome conflicts) from 921 rows, leaving 736, then made a stratified 80/20 split (seed 42). Test accuracy is measured on the 148 held-out rows.'}
json.dump(report,open('report.json','w'),indent=2)
print(report); print(len(pred), pd.Series(pred).value_counts().to_dict())
"
